scope: Actual Windows executable with compile-time ui-test picker adapter. Text/Markdown or text-layer PDF (pdfTest) import, atomic PDF failure/duplicate checks, retrieval and source display, DE/EN, injection as inert text, no evidence, missing model, workspace scope, lock, cancelled authentication, recovery, graceful close/restart. Optional sequential real BGE embedding/index and reranker test identified by embeddingTest. Combined model residency is not covered. OS picker not included; optional actual answer generation/streaming identified by generationTest.
